## `pvalr`

*Available in [R](#pvalr-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function helps print p-values in RMD output

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    pvalr(pvals, sig.limit = 0.001, digits = 3, html = FALSE, equal_sign = "")

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `pvals` - a vector of numeric p-values
    - `sig.limit` - A lower threshold below which to print "<sig.limit"
    - `digits` - how many digits to print?
    - `html` - uses the HTML symbol instead of normal < symbol
    - `equal_sign` - character value to append to front of p-value

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A character vector of "pretty" p values
